Hi Erin — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. I pulled the usage logs and I can reproduce the duplicate meter increments across the two invoice windows; this looks like an ingest re-run that duplicated a connector batch. Apologies for the disruption.

Proposed interim approach (to meet your Dec 10 close):
1) Provisional goodwill credit: Redwood will issue a provisional credit of EUR 10,500 + associated VAT handling (see split below). We can apply this as an automatic ledger credit to your account immediately (visible on next invoice) so you have something to book.
2) VAT split: We will issue the credit net of VAT on the service line (EUR 10,500) and document the VAT treatment as reverse-charge on the credit memo if you confirm Novasystems is VAT-registered in the EU and provides a VAT certificate. If not, we'll reapply VAT at the original rate and issue the full gross credit.
3) Staged posting: to reduce operational risk, we will post a provisional credit memo today for EUR 10,500 (net), and follow up with a formal paid refund (ACH/wire) if you prefer after we receive the VAT certificate and PO reference.
4) Timeline: provisional ledger entry by Dec 2, final reissue / refund by Dec 9 once we have paperwork.

Action items for Novasystems: please share your VAT registration certificate and the PO or invoice references you want on the credit memo (if any).

I've attached a provisional-credit-memo-NS-775.pdf stub that shows the net/gross breakdown and a suggested accounting description we can use. Laura from Finance is cc'd to coordinate the ledger route and any DocuSign acceptance steps.

If you prefer an immediate cash refund instead of a ledger credit, say the word and we'll escalate the approval path (it typically adds 1–2 business days).

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Enterprise — Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
Office: +1 415 555 0198
